mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue, description AS description, status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM sys_config ORDER BY config_key ASC

SELECT id AS id, config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue, description AS description, status AS status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime FROM sys_config WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_config ( config_key, config_value, description, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET config_key = #{configKey}, config_value = #{configValue}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
